---
title: "Labs"
---

The primary homework assignments in this course are lab assignments where you will use `python` and
occasionally other software to acquire, explore, wrangle, and manage different data sets.
**Please submit a PDF (preferred) or HTML file along with your `qmd` file.** Labs should be submitted
on Brightspace.

Each lab is released the week it is assigned; until then its link goes to a placeholder page.
Once released, the lab title links to the assignment and the "Template" link downloads the raw
`.qmd` for you to fill in.
